subject: REQUEST: cogarch fleet-wide patch — all agents need updated cogarch.config.json

content.summary: Session 14 made significant architectural changes that need to propagate to all agent cogarch configs. Operations-agent retired from chromabook. ops-session and psy-session became canonical session agents. mesh agent bootstrapped independently. Peer discovery URLs changed. Please coordinate the fleet-wide cogarch patch since you own the cogarch templates.
changes_requiring_patch: operations-agent removed as peer — replaced by ops-session
operations-agent.safety-quotient.dev URL defunct — remove from all discovery references
psy-session added as peer where missing
Budget schema: budget_spent/budget_cutoff/sleep_mode canonical everywhere (old schema dropped)
content.latitude: Full latitude to design the patch approach. PRs to each repo, direct SSH updates, or a fleet-wide script — your call. ops-session's cogarch already reflects the new architecture.
